crossRefs.note: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

translations.web: Then Yahweh’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
translations.bsb: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow passage between two vineyards, with walls on either side.
translations.kjv: But the angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall
translations.asv: Then the angel of Jehovah stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.
